calibrate_depth_maps: calibrate predicted depth maps against ground truth using scale, scale-shift, or RANSAC methods
resize_small_images: resize two images to match the smaller one using nearest neighbor interpolation
calibrate_scale_shift_linear: compute optimal scale and shift parameters via closed-form least squares regression
calibrate_scale_shift_ransac: compute robust scale and shift parameters using RANSAC regression to handle outliers
convert_depth_by_calibration: apply precomputed scale and shift calibration data to transform a depth map
